about: The fields the user fills in for each document in catalog.json, read by the backend (AI prompt, structured output schema, checks) and the frontend (cover page). party1 and party2 take the two partyRoles in order; the vendor-like side comes first, so carrying parties over when the user switches documents keeps each party on its side. Field kinds: text, date (blank means today), years (whole years, 1 to 99) and choice (one of options). carry marks fields (the effective date, governing law and courts) that keep their value when the user switches to another document with a field of the same key.
